item.title: Core Keeper Boss Fight Strategy — How to Beat Every Boss, Positioning and Gear
item.description: The boss guide covers where each boss lives, how to summon it and what it drops. This strategy guide is the fight itself: the health pools, the attack numbers, the enrage thresholds, and the positioning that turns a wipe into a farm. Rules that apply to almost every boss Enrage at a threshold. Most bosses switch to a faster, deadlier phase once you push them below a health percentage — the fight gets harder near the end, not easier.

item.title: Core Keeper Boss Guide — All 7 Bosses, Drops, Locations and Strategies
item.description: Core Keeper’s boss order follows your tool progression: three bosses around the Core must fall before it powers up, then the outer-ring titans open endgame content. This Core Keeper boss guide lists every boss, where they spawn, how to summon them and what they drop. The three early bosses (power up the Core) Defeat all three and place their drops on the effigies next to the Core to activate it.

item.title: Core Keeper Bosses & Combat FAQ — Boss Order, Drops, Farming
Enemy Health Bars
item.description: Enemy Health Bars is a Combat mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Shows HP bars for enemies, animals and NPCs — essential for boss fights and mob farming. What it does HP bars for enemies, animals and NPCs Invaluable for boss fights and judging farm kills Client-side; works on any server How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe.
